_comment: Canonical model-tier table. next/home/shared/harness/pi/models.json, dsh/settings.yaml's local-proxy provider block, and litellm/config.yaml's model_list are all generated from this file by jig (`src/domain/tiers/` + `bun src/cli/jig.ts apply`, run from harness/jig). Edit THIS file, then `jig apply`; never hand-edit a generated file directly except inside dsh's settings.yaml `# BEGIN jig:tiers` / `# END jig:tiers` markers, which jig also refuses to touch by hand once it owns them. Decision record: writeup store yoki/2026-09-16-observability-proxy-litellm; unified in the harness-parity plan, Phase 2.

_comment.baseUrl: confirm /v1 vs bare :4000 against the running proxy
_comment.compat: localhost gateways: pi-ai treats an unknown URL as OpenAI itself and sends fields LiteLLM may reject — these two are the usual fixes and have no UI field, so they must live here.
_comment.pi.apiKey: env interpolation: the `pi` shell wrapper (next/home/shared/zsh/rc/functions.zsh) resolves the op-managed proxy key ONCE at launch and exports LITELLM_API_KEY, so pi never spawns a key-reader in a subprocess that cannot reach the Keychain. Launch pi via that wrapper, not the raw binary.

_comment.apiKeyEnv: the PROXY master key, injected via `op run` (never on disk)

main._context_source: contextWindow 200000 = the harness BUDGET (compaction point), ruled 2026-09-24 (rules/decisions/2026-09-24-context-window-budget-200k-extended-1m.md): the value Claude Code falls back to behind a gateway, below the ~256K where DeepSeek MRCR drops (third-party). maxContextWindow 1000000 = the provider window (DeepSeek pricing table, deepseek-flash: CONTEXT LENGTH 1M, MAX OUTPUT MAXIMUM 384K, https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing), reachable in omp with /extended-context on. maxTokens 16384 is a deliberate output cap.

complex._context_source: contextWindow 200000 = the harness budget (same ruling as main). maxContextWindow 1000000 = the provider window (DeepSeek pricing table, deepseek-v4-pro column: CONTEXT LENGTH 1M, MAX OUTPUT MAXIMUM 384K).

_comment.name: dsh's hand-written comment still calls this route Astra (gpt-6-astra); litellm/config.yaml actually routes `complex` to deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro today (see that file's own comment on the swap) — pre-existing drift this schema records rather than silently resolving.

deterministic._context_source: contextWindow 131072 is the window LM Studio loads qwen3.8-27b with — NOT a model constant. litellm/check.sh prints the loaded context length (LM Studio REST v0 loaded_context_length); if it is lower, this value must follow it, or the tier overflows silently. [unverified against the live load as of 2026-09-24]
